answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 170677 Country: india Title: Regarding Zakat calculation Question: I am a private tutor and earn money through fees of the tuitions. Till end of year 2018, I accumulated 4 lakh. Now this year in 2019, by end Shaban my TOTAL amount in bank would be 8 lakh (that is 4 lakh of year 2018+4 lakh earned from Ramadan of 2018 till Shaban of 2019). I have a loan of Rs 75000. So how much Zakat will I have to pay? Answer ID: 170677 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 816/707/SD=09/1440) You will have to pay zakah on the remaining amount after deducting 75000 from eight lakh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
